subject.title: fix(agents): clamp zero bash job TTLs

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change the `OPENCLAW_BASH_JOB_TTL_MS=0` edge to the documented one-minute minimum, and should this maintainer replacement be the branch that carries it?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but it changes an existing env-var interpretation and there is another open contributor PR for the same root cause, so automation should not choose the landing branch or compatibility policy alone.

options.title: Land this maintainer replacement
options.body: Merge this focused branch, preserving the co-author credit, then close or supersede the duplicate contributor branch.

options.title: Land the contributor resubmission
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102818 as the canonical branch instead and close this replacement as unnecessary.

options.title: Preserve zero-as-default
options.body: Reject the behavior change if maintainers consider env zero a compatibility contract for the 30-minute default.

recommendation.title: Land this maintainer replacement
recommendation.body: Merge this focused branch, preserving the co-author credit, then close or supersede the duplicate contributor branch.
